title: A scalable linear programming-based framework for data clustering
summary: We extend the linear programming-based algorithm of De Rosa et al~\cite{derKhaWan24} for K-means clustering to two important clustering paradigms: fair K-means clustering and spectral clustering. For fair K-means clustering, we show that widely used notions of group fairness can be incorporated into the partition-matrix formulation of K-means clustering through a linear number of linear inequalities.
